confirmation.failureReason: Second independent review finds personality sufficient count unchanged at 6/8; the required gain is at least one. Primary finds 7/8 to 8/8.

decision.decision: Keep composed-v8 explicitly selectable as an experimental profile with measured scope improvements. Do not change the baseline default or promote the operational harness.
